items.stem: Which of the following statements is true about proportional ratios?
In the given table, which images have proportional ratios of width to height?

Nitin and Hari were building a compound wall. Nitin built a longer side of 60 ft using 3 bags of cement, and Hari built a shorter side of 40 ft using 2 bags of cement. Are the ratios of the length of the wall to the number of bags of cement used by Nitin and Hari proportional?
If the ratio of the number of glasses of lemonade to the number of spoons of sugar is 6 : 10, how many spoons of sugar should be used to make 18 glasses of lemonade to maintain the same sweetness?
If the ratio of width to height of a rectangular image is 60 : 40, which of the following is a simplified form of this ratio?
If the ratio of width to height of an image is 60 : 40, and the width is reduced to 30 mm, what should the new height be to maintain the same ratio?
What is the ratio of Neelima’s age to her mother’s age when Neelima is 3 years old?
In the passage, it is mentioned that when Neelima is 3 years old, her mother’s age is 10 times her age. What is the ratio of their ages when Neelima is 12 years old?
If the ratio of coffee decoction to milk in a cup of coffee is 15 : 35, and a customer wants a stronger coffee, which of the following ratios would represent a stronger coffee?
In the passage, it is mentioned that the cook makes 15 kg of rice for 120 students. If only 80 students come, how many kilograms of rice should be made?
If a:b::c:d, which of the following is true?
A car travels 90 km in 150 minutes. How far will it travel in 4 hours if it continues at the same speed?
Two ratios are proportional if their terms are equal when cross multiplied. Which of the following shows this property?
Puneeth’s father travels from Lucknow to Kanpur in 2 hours at 50 km/h. If he increases his speed to 75 km/h, how long will it take him?
A mason requires 1450 bricks to build a 10-foot wall. How many bricks would be needed to build a 15-foot wall, assuming the same height and thickness?
What is the simplest form of the ratio when 12 counters are divided equally between two people?
If the ratio of counters between two people is 3 : 1 and there are 12 counters in total, how many counters does the second person get?
A farmer sells 200 g of tea for ₹200, and a large estate sells 1 kg of tea for ₹800. Are the weight-to-price ratios proportional?
In a mixture, acid and water are in the ratio 1 : 5. If the total volume is 240 mL, how much acid is in the mixture?
What is the simplest form of the ratio of grey bricks to coloured bricks in the pattern shown in the passage?
A farmer needs to apply 10 tonnes of cow manure for 1 acre of land. How much manure is needed for a 200 ft by 500 ft plot?
If a tap fills a 500 mL mug in 15 seconds, how long will it take to fill a 10 L bucket?
A ₹10 coin is made of copper and nickel in a 3:1 ratio. If the mass of the coin is 7.74 grams, what is the mass of nickel in the coin?
A tractor ploughs 4 times faster than a pair of oxen. How much time will a tractor take to plough 20 acres if a pair of oxen takes 6 hours to plough 1 acre?
What is the ratio of grey bricks to coloured bricks in the first pattern shown in the passage?
If 1 litre of water has a mass of 1 kg, what is the mass of 1 litre of gold, given that the ratio of the mass of gold to water is 37 : 2?
What is the ratio of grey bricks to coloured bricks in the second pattern shown in the passage?
If 3 buses can carry 162 people, how many buses are needed for 204 people?
If the area of Delhi is 1,484 sq. km and the area of Mumbai is 550 sq. km, and their populations are 30 million and 20 million respectively, which city is more crowded?
When a quantity is divided in the ratio m : n, what is the total number of groups into which the quantity is divided?
If 2 palas of saffron costs niskas, how much saffron can be bought for 9 niskas?
A mixture of 40 kg contains sand and cement in the ratio of 3 : 1. How much cement should be added to the mixture to make the ratio of sand to cement 5 : 2?
In a proportion a:b::c:d, which of the following is correct?
What is the simplest form of the ratio of 600 mL of orange juice to 900 mL of apple juice?
What is the ratio of orange juice to apple juice if Anagh mixes 600 mL of orange juice with 900 mL of apple juice?
What is the ratio of teachers to students in a school with 5 teachers and 170 students?
What is the ratio of copper to nickel in a ₹10 coin?
If a tractor can plough 1 acre of land in 1.5 hours, how long will it take to plough 20 acres of land?
If the ratio of coffee decoction to milk in a cup of coffee is 15 : 35, what is the simplified form of this ratio?
In a mixture, sand and cement are in the ratio 3 : 1. If the total weight of the mixture is 40 kg, how much cement is in the mixture?
